vocabulary.definition: This is a way of saying that a company has just released some new kind of product. "I'm going to get a new phone when Apple finally comes out with the Iphone 5"
This is a way of saying that some company or store made the price lower. Electronics companies often drop the prices of their products when they come out with something better.
If something goes "out of production" it means they have stopped making it. There may be some left in stores but they will never be making any more new ones.

vocabulary.term: It's good enough for my needs
vocabulary.definition: If something is "good enough for your needs" it means that it is totally good enough for what you are planning on doing with it. Some people always buy the most expensive computers even if all they ever do is surf the internet. Some people who care a bit more about how they spend their money try to buy the computer that is "good enough for their needs".
This is a word for people who make websites and apps and other digital things. These are the "coders" and not the "graphic designers".

If someone "quotes you" with a time, it is an estimate or a guess as to how long something will take. Certain jobs require both a time and money quote. This is supposed to be an honest guess for how long something will take and how much it should cost.

If you've had "mixed results" with something it means that you've tried doing the same thing a few times and had different results each time. I've heard mixed results with that new weight loss method.

vocabulary.term: I have a good feeling about
vocabulary.definition: If you have "a good feeling about something" it means that you aren't exactly sure why but you think something good will come true. I have a good feeling it's going to be a nice sunny day next Saturday for their wedding.
If someone is "on the ball" it means they are very sharp, always on time, and learn new things quickly.

If you look at a web developer's or any free lancer's "portfolio" it means you are looking at a big collection of their best work. This word is often used for photographers, and website designers. It is also used to describe all the stocks or investments someone owns if they are into investing.
